info.title: Kallabot API
info.description:
The Kallabot API lets you build and run AI agents that answer and make phone calls and reply on
WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and website chat.

- **Base URL:** `https://api.kallabot.com`
- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer kb_live_…` (create a key in the dashboard under Settings → API keys).
  Each operation lists the scopes its key needs. A workspace key (`kb_live_…`) belongs to the workspace;
  a personal key (`kbp_live_…`) acts as the person who made it, within their role, and is logged under
  their name. Operations marked **Needs a personal key** need someone behind them, so only a personal
  key works there. The browser side of a web call is the exception: its
  `/client` operations take only the session's `X-Webcall-Grant`, so your key never reaches the page.
- **Errors:** every error is `application/problem+json` with a stable `code` ([error reference](https://docs.kallabot.com/developers/errors)).
- **Retries:** send an `Idempotency-Key` on creates and control actions; a retry with the same key never runs twice.
- **Rate limits:** every response carries `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`;
  a `429` carries `Retry-After`.
- **Versions:** the API is versioned by date. Send `Kallabot-Version: 2026-11-07` to pin the version
  you built against; without it you get the current version (`2026-11-07`). Every response names the
  version that answered in `Kallabot-Version`, and an unknown version is refused with 400
  `unsupported_api_version`.
- **Lists:** every list takes `limit` and `cursor` and answers `{data, next_cursor, has_more}`. Pass
  `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page; cursors are opaque.
- **Concurrency:** reads of versioned objects carry an `ETag` (the revision in quotes, e.g. `"7"`); send it back as
  `If-Match` and a stale write is refused with 412. Where `If-Match` is marked required, a write without it gets 428.
- **SDKs:** the official SDKs send `X-Kallabot-SDK`. A deprecated release gets a `Kallabot-SDK-Warning` header;
  a release that has been switched off is refused with 426 `sdk_version_unsupported` and must upgrade.
- **Webhooks:** every event Kallabot sends is listed under Webhooks with its payload, signed with
  [Standard Webhooks](https://docs.kallabot.com/developers/webhooks) headers.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Create, version, publish and archive the AI agents that answer and make calls and chats.

tags.name: Calls
tags.description: Place phone calls, read them back with transcripts, recordings and timings, and control live calls.

tags.name: Scheduled calls
tags.description: Book an outbound call for later; Kallabot dials at the right time in the callee's time zone.

tags.name: Web calls
tags.description: Start a voice call from a browser (WebRTC) with a short-lived grant.

tags.name: Tools
tags.description: Give agents actions: HTTP API tools, MCP servers, and the secrets they use.

tags.name: Knowledge
tags.description: Index websites, files and catalogs so agents answer from your own facts.

tags.name: Numbers
tags.description: Search, buy and configure phone numbers, port numbers in, and choose caller IDs.

tags.name: SIP trunks
tags.description: Bring your own carrier over SIP and attach its numbers to agents.

tags.name: Inbox
tags.description: Read chat threads from WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram and web chat, and manage their state.

tags.name: Web chat
tags.description: Create and publish website chat widgets.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Receive signed events when calls end, messages arrive and more; inspect and replay deliveries.

tags.name: Minutes
tags.description: Read the workspace's minutes and move them between the pool and people.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: See the plan, prices and invoices; open Checkout or the billing portal, sync seats and set auto top-up. Money is integer minor units plus `currency`.

**Scopes:** `agent:write`

**Scopes:** `agent:read`

patch.description:
Changes the agent's configuration, name, owner or team. A new configuration is saved as a draft version; callers keep hearing the published version until you publish. To change only the WhatsApp greeting and instructions or the knowledge sources, send `whatsapp` and/or `knowledge_ids` instead of a whole `config`: every other setting stays as it is, and when the agent was live with nothing else unpublished and your key has `agent:publish`, the change goes live at once (`published: true`). Send `If-Match` with the `revision` you read and an `Idempotency-Key`; a stale revision is refused.

**Scopes:** `agent:write`

``channels`` narrows where the agent may use it (default: everywhere the

every tool the server doesn't mark destructive is offered.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: semantic (default): Smart Turn listens to the waveform and the LLM then judges whether the thought was actually finished, emitting a hidden ✓/○/◐ marker. On ○ or ◐ the reply is withheld and the caller keeps the floor — this is what stops the agent answering 'my number is four one five...' mid-sequence. smart_turn: the acoustic model alone; one less judgement, slightly cheaper, and it will cut a slow speaker off. provider: Soniox's own semantic endpointing, no local compute, and the only option with numeric sensitivity controls. All three are mutually exclusive.

max_wait_sec.title: Max Wait Sec
max_wait_sec.description: Backstop for when the turn model never reaches a confident verdict. Default 0.7 on semantic turns (the LLM still holds a half line) and 1.2 otherwise. This is NOT the turn timer, but it is not free either: when the model cannot decide, the caller waits this long in silence. Raising it makes an undecided turn read as a dropped call; lowering it below about a second makes the agent interrupt people.

claim_secs.description: While the agent is speaking, how long caller speech must continue before it claims the floor. Default 0.45: brief acknowledgements do not interrupt, while a real barge-in is respected before it feels talked over.

ringback_settle_sec.title: Ringback Settle Sec
ringback_settle_sec.description: When protect_greeting is enabled, how long after our opening audio starts before carrier leakage is no longer muted. Default 0.6.

resume_short_sec.title: Resume Short Sec
resume_short_sec.description: semantic only. After ○ (cut off mid-sentence), sit silent this long waiting for them to carry on, then hand the floor back. Default 1.5.

resume_long_sec.title: Resume Long Sec
resume_long_sec.description: Deprecated compatibility field. ◐ side-talk/hold turns now remain silent until the caller resumes; automatic check-ins felt intrusive.

min_volume.title: Min Volume

stop_secs.title: Stop Secs
stop_secs.description: Silence before VAD reports the caller stopped. Default 0.20. This is not the same as deciding the caller has finished — Smart Turn and the completion model do that — so raising it mostly adds latency to every turn and shrinks the window Smart Turn has to wait for the final transcript.
